6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartTestPoint
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentationSplit
9	
10	/-!
11	# Split witnesses from rank-one presentations at a field (Task-C steps D0 + D1)
12	
13	Two converse-direction bricks for the rank-one openness lane.
14	
15	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.exists_overSpecMap_testPoint_comp` (D0) — **testPoint naturality
16	  in the slice**: for `f : T' ⟶ T` over `Spec k` and a point `t` of `T'.left`, the
17	  naturality square of the residue-field bridge (`Over.testPoint_comp_left`) is promoted
18	  to an equation of slice morphisms through a `k`-algebra map of the two residue fields.
19	  The algebra-map upgrade of `testPointFieldMap` is not done by hand: it is delegated to
20	  `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing`, whose `Spec.preimage` performs it once.
21	
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.isSplitWitness` (D1) — **the field
23	  converse of the presentation contract**: a `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` of a
24	  genus-degree class over a field `K` yields `IsSplitWitness` for that class.  The
25	  splitting field is a finite separable single-factor refinement of the presentation's
26	  étale cover (`Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`); the presenting
27	  equation is the plus-class field collapse (`PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom`) read
28	  through `P.datum_class`; the witness divisor comes from the presentation's own
29	  `H¹`-vanishing through the datum dictionary
30	  (`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton`).
31	
32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field` — membership of a field
33	  class in `PicRankOneOpen` implies `IsSplitWitness`, by testing with the identity.
34	  Together with the landed `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness` this is the fibrewise
35	  characterization of the rank-one locus at fields.
36	-/
37	
38	set_option autoImplicit false
39	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
40	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
41	
42	universe u
43	
44	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
45	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
46	
47	open scoped TensorProduct
48	
49	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
50	
51	open AlgebraicJacobian
52	
53	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
54	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
55	
56	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
57	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
58	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
59	
60	noncomputable section
61	
62	/-! ## D0: testPoint naturality in the slice -/
63	
64	/-- **testPoint naturality as an equation of slice morphisms** (Task-C D0).  For a
65	morphism of tests `f : T' ⟶ T` over `Spec k` and a point `t : T'.left`, there is a
66	`k`-algebra map `φ : κ(f t) →ₐ[k] κ(t)` through which the field point of `t` composed
67	with `f` is the field point of `f t`.
68	
69	This is `Over.testPoint_comp_left` upgraded from the underlying schemes to the slice: the
70	underlying map of the connecting morphism is `Spec` of `Over.testPointFieldMap f t`, and
71	its `k`-algebra structure is recovered by `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing`
72	rather than assembled by hand. -/
73	theorem Over.exists_overSpecMap_testPoint_comp
74	    {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
75	    ∃ φ : Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t) →ₐ[k]
76	        Over.testPointField (T := T') t,
77	      Over.testPoint t ≫ f
78	        = Over.overSpecMap φ ≫ Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t) := by
79	  have hw : Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
80	        ≫ (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))).hom
81	      = (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T') t)).hom := by
82	    calc Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
83	          ≫ (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))).hom
84	        = Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
85	            ≫ ((Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t)).left ≫ T.hom) := by
86	          rw [Over.w (Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t))]
87	      _ = ((Over.testPoint t).left ≫ f.left) ≫ T.hom := by
88	          rw [← Category.assoc, ← Over.testPoint_comp_left f t]
89	      _ = (Over.testPoint t).left ≫ T'.hom := by
90	          rw [Category.assoc, Over.w f]
91	      _ = (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T') t)).hom :=
92	          Over.w (Over.testPoint t)
93	  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing (k := k)
94	    (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))
95	    (Over.testPointField (T := T') t)
96	    (Over.homMk (Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)) hw)
97	  refine ⟨φ, ?_⟩
98	  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
99	  rw [Over.comp_left, Over.comp_left, ← hφ, Over.homMk_left]
100	  exact Over.testPoint_comp_left f t
101	
102	/-! ## D1: presentation at a field ⇒ split witness -/
103	
104	/-- Triviality of a module is preserved by any coefficient extension: a tensor product
105	with a subsingleton factor is a subsingleton. -/
106	private theorem subsingleton_tensorProduct_of_subsingleton_left
107	    {R X Y : Type u} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X]
108	    [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y] (h : Subsingleton X) :
109	    Subsingleton (X ⊗[R] Y) := by
110	  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun z => ?_
111	  induction z with
112	  | zero => rfl
113	  | tmul x y => rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
114	  | add u v hu hv => rw [hu, hv, add_zero]
115	
116	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
117	-- The plus-class field collapse through the base-changed étale carrier needs the larger
118	-- budget (same as `isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_of_algHom`).
119	/-- **The field converse of the rank-one presentation contract** (Task-C D1): a
120	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` of a genus-degree class over a field `K` makes that class a
121	split witness.
122	
123	The splitting field `L` is a finite separable single-factor refinement of the
124	presentation's étale cover.  The presenting Čech class is the image of the presentation's
125	own `P.datum.cechPicClass` under the carrier-to-`L` refinement, by the plus-class field
126	collapse; its witness divisor with vanishing `H¹` exists because the presentation's
127	`h1_vanishing` field survives the coefficient extension to `L` (`0 ⊗ = 0`), which is
128	exactly the datum dictionary's condition at `L`. -/
129	theorem PicRankOneLocalPresentation.isSplitWitness
130	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
131	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
132	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K)}
133	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
134	    IsSplitWitness C lam.1 := by
135	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hKL, hLfin, hLsep, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ :=
136	    P.cover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
137	  letI := hLf
138	  letI := hKL
139	  letI := hLfin
140	  letI := hLsep
141	  letI hkL : Algebra k L := ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap k K)).toAlgebra
142	  haveI htowkKL : IsScalarTower k K L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
143	  letI hBL : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
144	  haveI htowKBL : IsScalarTower K P.cover.Carrier L :=
145	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (ψ.commutes x).symm
146	  haveI htowkBL : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
147	    change algebraMap k L x = ψ (algebraMap k P.cover.Carrier x)
148	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K P.cover.Carrier, ψ.commutes,
149	      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K L]
150	  have hM : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K lam.1)
151	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
152	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
153	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
154	    rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom C P.representative ψ,
155	      P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
156	  have hsub : Subsingleton ((datumPair P.datum).H1 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] L) :=
157	    subsingleton_tensorProduct_of_subsingleton_left
158	      ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
159	  obtain ⟨W, hW, hW1⟩ :=
160	    (P.datum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton L).mpr hsub
161	  exact isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness C lam.1
162	    (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L) P.datum.cechPicClass)
163	    hM W hW hW1
164	
165	/-- **Membership of a field class in the public rank-one locus implies the split-witness
166	condition** — the converse of `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness`, obtained by testing
167	the membership contract with the identity of `overSpec k K`.  Together the two theorems
168	characterize the rank-one locus fibrewise at fields. -/
169	theorem isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field
170	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
171	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
172	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K)}
173	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K))) :
174	    IsSplitWitness C lam.1 := by
175	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mp h K (𝟙 (overSpec k K))
176	  have e : ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map
177	        (𝟙 (overSpec k K)).op lam).1 = lam.1 :=
178	    picEtMap_id C lam.1
179	  have hsplit := P.isSplitWitness
180	  rwa [e] at hsplit
181	
182	end
183	
184	end AlgebraicGeometry
